title: Revealing and Classification of Deepfakes Video's Images using a Customize Convolution Neural Network Model
decisive_datasets_tasks: Kaggle deepfake-video frames; the workflow extracts faces, preprocesses face crops, and compares a custom CNN with CNN/MLP-CNN classifiers.
mechanism: Passive frame-level classification after face extraction from deepfake videos.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The evaluated images are face crops extracted from face-swap/deepfake video.
rationale: The primary experiment is a face-swap/video-frame detector with no independent broader synthetic-image benchmark.

title: DeepGuardNet: A Novel CNN Architecture for DeepFake Image Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: Celeb-DF is the reported experimental dataset; DeepGuardNet is evaluated as a real-versus-deepfake face classifier.
mechanism: Passive depthwise-separable CNN detection of facial deepfakes.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The decisive benchmark is Celeb-DF and no broader general-content AIGI evaluation is reported.
rationale: The contribution is limited to facial deepfake recognition under the current narrowed policy.

title: Deep fake detection and classification using error-level analysis and deep learning
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary experiment uses the Yonsei real/fake human-face image collection; ELA-derived images feed CNN feature extractors and SVM/KNN classifiers.
mechanism: Passive error-level analysis plus learned face-image classification.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The reviewed experimental images are real and deepfake human faces.
rationale: The paper evaluates only face imagery, so it is legacy scope drift rather than a general synthetic-image detector.

title: Testing human ability to detect ‘deepfake’ images of human faces
decisive_datasets_tasks: The human-subject study uses 50 StyleGAN2/FFHQ-generated human faces and 50 real FFHQ faces, sampling 20 images per participant.
mechanism: Human visual detection of fully generated face images.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Although the faces are fully generated, every evaluated image is a human face from FFHQ/StyleGAN2.
rationale: The study is exclusively about human recognition of generated faces and has no broader still-image forensic task.

title: Deepfake Image Detection Using Vision Transformer Models
decisive_datasets_tasks: A 40,000-image Kaggle real/deepfake collection is used to train and test the Vision Transformer; the reviewed dataset is a face-deepfake image collection.
mechanism: Passive ViT binary classification of deepfake face images.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. No independently evaluated non-face synthetic-image subset is reported.
rationale: The experimental endpoint remains face-deepfake detection despite the generic wording of the title.

title: MaskGAN: A Facial Fusion Algorithm for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: MaskGAN generates face-swapping images with fusion masks; those face swaps train an improved DeepLabV3+ detector for known and unknown face-tampering methods.
mechanism: Facial fusion generation followed by passive face-swap detection/localization.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Generation, labels, and evaluation are confined to facial fusion and face swapping.
rationale: The paper's generalization claim is across face-tampering methods, not across broader synthetic-image content.

title: Deepfake Image Detection using CNNs and Transfer Learning
decisive_datasets_tasks: The accessible primary abstract describes a custom CNN and transfer-learning approach but does not name the datasets, generators, or manipulation classes used in the experiments.
mechanism: Passive CNN/transfer-learning deepfake image classification; benchmark scope is unverified.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: No primary experimental detail available in the preserved evidence establishes either face-only or broader synthetic-image coverage.
exact_evidence_needed: Which named datasets, generators, and manipulation classes are evaluated in the primary paper, and do they include a substantive non-face synthetic-image task?
rationale: The preserved primary evidence does not expose the experimental dataset section, so the face-only versus broader scope boundary cannot be resolved.

title: Face X-Ray for More General Face Forgery Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: Face X-Ray is evaluated on face-forgery benchmarks and unseen facial manipulation methods; its target is the blending boundary created when an altered face is composited into a face image.
mechanism: Passive face-forgery detection from facial blending-boundary traces.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The method and all decisive evaluations concern facial manipulation.
rationale: Generalization to unseen face-forgery methods does not establish a broader synthetic-image contribution.

title: Global Texture Enhancement for Fake Face Detection in the Wild
decisive_datasets_tasks: Table 8 separately evaluates 10,000 natural ImageNet images against 10,000 BigGAN-generated ImageNet images and reports 80.29% accuracy, in addition to the paper's face experiments.
mechanism: Passive global-texture detection using Gram-matrix statistics, tested for robustness to editing and unseen generators.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Yes. The independent fake-natural-image experiment demonstrates synthetic-image detection beyond facial imagery.
rationale: The title emphasizes faces, but the evaluated contribution includes a substantive non-face synthetic-image condition, satisfying the narrowed scope.

title: Analysis Survey on Deepfake detection and Recognition with Convolutional Neural Networks
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary survey reviews CNN-based image/video deepfake generation and detection methods, with its technical scope organized around facial/identity deepfakes rather than general AIGI benchmarks.
mechanism: Survey of passive facial deepfake recognition methods.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The review does not contribute an independent broader synthetic-image forensic evaluation or benchmark.
rationale: Its surveyed contribution is bounded to deepfake/face media and does not independently cover the map's narrowed general-image scope.

title: A Review on Deepfake Image Detection Approaches, Techniques and Methods
decisive_datasets_tasks: The accessible primary review abstract reports a taxonomy of deepfake-image approaches and internet case studies, but the preserved source does not expose the included-study table or dataset coverage needed to establish broader AIGI scope.
mechanism: Literature review/taxonomy of deepfake image detection; exact empirical coverage is unavailable.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Unverified. The abstract alone does not show whether the review substantively covers general synthetic images outside facial deepfakes.
exact_evidence_needed: Which included primary studies and named datasets define the review's empirical scope, and is broader non-face synthetic-image detection covered substantively rather than mentioned incidentally?
rationale: The accessible primary material is insufficient to distinguish a pure deepfake review from a broader synthetic-image forensic review.

title: DeepSight: Enhancing Deepfake Image Detection and Classification through Ensemble and Deep Learning Techniques
decisive_datasets_tasks: The accessible primary abstract says DeepSight is evaluated on benchmark datasets and across deepfake generation techniques, but it does not name the datasets or disclose whether their content is face-only.
mechanism: Passive ensemble classification using CNN features with Random Forest, KNN, and XGBoost.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Unverified. No preserved primary table or dataset section establishes an independent broader synthetic-image evaluation.
exact_evidence_needed: Which named benchmark datasets and generation methods are used in DeepSight's experiments, and do any independently evaluate non-face fully generated or generatively edited images?
rationale: Generic references to benchmark datasets and generation techniques cannot settle the narrowed-scope question.

title: CNN-LSTM Model for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary evaluation uses FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF video frames; the CNN extracts spatial face features and the LSTM models temporal/frame context.
mechanism: Passive spatiotemporal classification of face-deepfake video frames.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Both named benchmarks are facial deepfake datasets and there is no broader image benchmark.
rationale: The image samples are frames from face-deepfake videos, so the contribution remains pure face/video forensics.

title: GAN Generated Fake Human Face Image Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: The experiment detects StyleGAN3-generated fake human faces against real human-face images and reports binary face-image accuracy.
mechanism: Passive CNN detection of fully generated GAN faces.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The target domain is explicitly human faces, with no non-face synthetic-image evaluation.
rationale: Fully generated faces alone remain pure face forensics under the current narrowed policy.

title: A Novel Framework for Deepfake Image Detection Using Deep Learning Approach
decisive_datasets_tasks: The accessible primary abstract reports a CNN+VGG16 framework and an unnamed 'deepfake dataset' with accuracy/precision, but it does not identify the dataset or manipulation classes.
mechanism: Passive CNN/VGG16 deepfake classification; benchmark scope is unverified.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: No preserved primary experimental evidence establishes broader non-face AIGI coverage.
exact_evidence_needed: What is the exact deepfake dataset used by the CNN/VGG16 framework, what content and manipulation classes does it contain, and is any broader synthetic-image subset independently evaluated?
rationale: Without the named dataset and experimental composition, the paper cannot be classified confidently as face-only or broader synthetic-image forensics.

title: Deepfakes Creation and Detection Using Deep Learning
decisive_datasets_tasks: The accessible primary abstract discusses creating and detecting deepfakes with deep learning and proposes image enhancement, but names no dataset, generator suite, or evaluation protocol.
mechanism: Deepfake creation, enhancement, and passive detection; experimental scope is unavailable.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Unverified. The preserved source does not establish either a substantive broader synthetic-image task or a face-only benchmark.
exact_evidence_needed: Which named datasets, generation/manipulation methods, and detection experiments are reported in the full primary paper, and do they include independently evaluated non-face synthetic images?
rationale: The abstract-level primary evidence is too sparse to resolve the current scope boundary.

title: Detection of Deep-Morphed Deepfake Images to Make Robust Automatic Facial Recognition Systems
decisive_datasets_tasks: DeepfakeTIMIT-HQ is the reported benchmark for detecting deep-morphed attacks against automatic facial-recognition systems.
mechanism: Passive CNN detection of deep-morphed face images for biometric security.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The sole decisive task is facial morph/deepfake attack detection.
rationale: The contribution is a face-biometric attack detector, not broader synthetic-image forensics.

title: Deepfake Image Detection Using Yolov8
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary study evaluates YOLOv8, CNN, CNN-LSTM, and ResNet on a 190,402-image real/fake human-face collection.
mechanism: Passive binary face-deepfake image classification.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The evaluated corpus consists of real and synthetic human faces.
rationale: The large sample count does not broaden the task beyond face-only deepfake detection.

title: DeepFake Detection Based on Discrepancies Between Faces and Their Context
decisive_datasets_tasks: FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF-v2 are the principal benchmarks for detecting face swaps and identity manipulation from discrepancies between a face and its hair/ears/neck context.
mechanism: Passive face-versus-context identity-consistency detection.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Both the task definition and benchmarks are facial identity manipulations.
rationale: The detector is explicitly designed for face swapping and other identity manipulations.

title: BiHPF: Bilateral High-Pass Filters for Robust Deepfake Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: Section 5.1 and Tables 2-5 evaluate LSUN/ImageNet real images and ProGAN, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, BigGAN, CycleGAN, and StarGAN fakes across non-face categories including horse, car, cat, and church.
mechanism: Passive bilateral high-pass filtering to emphasize generator artifacts and improve robustness/generalization.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Yes. The independently reported general GAN-image condition extends the forensic task beyond face-only deepfakes.
rationale: The broader synthetic-image experiment is substantive, so the paper remains within the narrowed corpus despite its deepfake title.

title: CNN Detection of GAN-Generated Face Images based on Cross-Band Co-occurrences Analysis
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary experiments distinguish GAN-generated from natural face images using spatial and cross-band co-occurrence features and test robustness to geometric, filtering, and contrast post-processing.
mechanism: Passive spectral cross-band co-occurrence classification of GAN faces.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The method is specifically developed and evaluated for synthetic face images.
rationale: Robustness testing does not create a broader synthetic-image contribution when the evaluated domain remains faces.

title: Cross-Forgery Analysis of Vision Transformers and CNNs for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: Cross-forgery experiments use ForgeryNet and compare a Vision Transformer with EfficientNetV2 across face-forgery methods.
mechanism: Passive generalization analysis across facial forgery generation methods.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. ForgeryNet's evaluated task in this paper is face/deepfake manipulation.
rationale: Cross-method generalization is confined to facial forgery and therefore conflicts with the narrowed scope.

title: C2P-CLIP: Injecting Category Common Prompt in CLIP to Enhance Generalization in Deepfake Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary evaluation spans 20 generation models in the generalizable synthetic-image detection protocol, covering multiple GAN, diffusion, and other image-generator families rather than a face-only benchmark.
mechanism: Passive CLIP prompt-learning detector with a category-common prompt for cross-generator generalization.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Yes. Broad general-content synthetic images from 20 generators are independently evaluated.
rationale: The experimental scope is general AI-generated still images, so the deepfake label does not indicate pure face forensics.

title: Deepfake Image Detection with Transfer Learning Models
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary study evaluates seven transfer-learning backbones on a 190,000-image public real/fake human-face dataset.
mechanism: Passive transfer-learning classification of real versus deepfake face images.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The dataset's image content is human faces.
rationale: The reported real/fake dataset is face-only and provides no independent broader synthetic-image task.

title: DeepFake Detection Improvement for Images Based on a Proposed Method for Local Binary Pattern of the Multiple-Channel Color Space
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary experiment uses FFHQ/face-deepfake imagery and evaluates the IR-CLBP-MC color-space representation for still-image deepfake detection.
mechanism: Passive handcrafted local-binary-pattern re-representation plus face-image classification.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The decisive benchmark and task are confined to generated/manipulated faces.
rationale: The still-image modality does not change the fact that the evaluated content is face-only.

title: DeepFake Face Image Detection based on Improved VGG Convolutional Neural Network
decisive_datasets_tasks: Celeb-DF is the reported experimental dataset; NA-VGG uses SRM noise filtering and augmentation to classify forged face images.
mechanism: Passive noise-residual CNN detection of face deepfakes.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Celeb-DF is the sole decisive face-forgery benchmark.
rationale: The experiment is limited to facial deepfakes and lacks broader synthetic-image evaluation.

title: SMNDNet for Multiple Types of Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary taxonomy and experiments cover entire-face synthesis, identity-swap face forgery, expression-swap face forgery, and attribute-manipulated face forgery (EFSF, ISFF, ESFF, and AMFF).
mechanism: Passive multi-class/multi-type detection of facial deepfakes.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. All four evaluated forgery types are facial synthesis or manipulation.
rationale: Multiple deepfake types do not broaden the paper beyond pure face forensics.

title: Detecting Deepfake Images Using Deep Learning Techniques and Explainable AI Methods
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary contribution applies deep classifiers and XAI explanations to deepfake face images; the reviewed task definition is replacement of one person's likeness in pictures/video.
mechanism: Passive face-deepfake classification with post-hoc explainability.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. No independent general-content synthetic-image benchmark is reported.
rationale: Explainability is applied to a face-only deepfake detector and does not establish broader scope.

title: An Eyes-Based Siamese Neural Network for the Detection of GAN-Generated Face Images
decisive_datasets_tasks: Primary experiments compare real and GAN-generated faces under matched/unmatched generator conditions and post-processing, using inter-eye pairs as the forensic signal.
mechanism: Passive Siamese similarity analysis of eye-region inconsistencies in generated faces.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Every evaluated sample and feature is tied to human faces.
rationale: The generator-generalization study remains strictly face-only.

title: A Novel Deep Learning Approach for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: The reported dataset contains real and fake faces; the proposed VGG16/CNN Deepfake Predictor is compared with Xception, NASNet, MobileNet, and VGG16 transfer models.
mechanism: Passive face-deepfake binary classification.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The experimental corpus is explicitly a real/fake face dataset.
rationale: The paper has no broader synthetic-image benchmark beyond human faces.

title: Multiclass AI-Generated Deepfake Face Detection Using Patch-Wise Deep Learning Model
decisive_datasets_tasks: The multiclass dataset separates real human faces, StyleGAN2-generated faces, and Stable-Diffusion-generated faces for patch-wise ViT/CNN comparison.
mechanism: Passive multiclass detection/source-family classification of generated face images.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Stable Diffusion is present, but the evaluated content remains exclusively faces.
rationale: Mentioning and evaluating diffusion does not establish general-image scope when all classes are face images.

title: A Hybrid CNN-LSTM Approach for Precision Deepfake Image Detection Based on Transfer Learning
decisive_datasets_tasks: DFDC and Ciplab are the named open-source benchmarks; the CNN-LSTM combines spatial face cues with temporal context for deepfake recognition.
mechanism: Passive spatiotemporal face-deepfake detection.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. Both decisive datasets and the stated target are fake faces/deepfake media.
rationale: The method is a facial/video deepfake system without a broader still-image experiment.

title: Semantic-Aware Lightweight AI Model for Deepfake Image Detection in Online Retail Platforms
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary study uses the public Karki real/fake collection; the preserved dataset description establishes that its samples are human faces.
mechanism: Passive lightweight ShuffleNet plus semantic-knowledge-graph classification of face deepfakes.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: None. The e-commerce framing does not add a non-face synthetic-image benchmark.
rationale: The actual evaluated data are face-only despite the generic online-retail application framing.

title: Data-Independent Operator: A Training-Free Artifact Representation Extractor for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
decisive_datasets_tasks: Primary tables evaluate the training-free Data-Independent Operator across 33 generator models/families, including GAN, diffusion, and commercial text-to-image systems such as DALL-E and Midjourney.
mechanism: Passive data-independent artifact representation extraction for cross-generator detection.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Yes. The evaluated images span broad non-face, general-content synthetic imagery and many generator families.
rationale: The method directly addresses general AI-generated-image detection, so it remains in scope.

title: Deepfake Detection Without Deepfakes: Generalization via Synthetic Frequency Patterns Injection
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary evaluation covers 25 generation methods spanning GAN, diffusion, and commercial image generators; synthetic frequency patterns are injected during detector training without requiring generated training images.
mechanism: Passive general synthetic-image detection learned through frequency-pattern injection.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Yes. Broad multi-generator still-image testing is the central evaluation.
rationale: The paper is a general synthetic-image detector, not a pure face-deepfake detector.

title: Text Modality Oriented Image Feature Extraction for Detecting Diffusion-Based DeepFake
decisive_datasets_tasks: The primary experimental section evaluates TOFE across ten diffusion-generation types in a general diffusion-image detection protocol.
mechanism: Passive text-oriented image-feature extraction for diffusion-generated image detection.
broader_synthetic_image_evidence: Yes. The evaluated diffusion imagery is a substantive general synthetic-image task rather than a face-only condition.
rationale: Detection across ten diffusion types falls squarely within the narrowed synthetic-image scope.
